# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260611T134021Z-api_hedge_order_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: 96145b1775c02629.
# Replays the hedge-order rule matrix (AORD-006) observed on 2026-06-11
# against live paper Gateway, five live-attested rules on far-from-market
# LMT parents:
#   - delta_hedge_compliant (419): zero-size stock delta child (D, ratio
#     0.5) of an OPTION parent (418) -> code 320 "Invalid hedge ratio".
#   - delta_hedge_stock_parent (421): sized stock delta child of a STOCK
#     parent (420) -> code 320 "Invalid delta hedge order. The parent order
#     has to be option order ...".
#   - beta_hedge_zero_size (422, B ratio 1.0) and pair_hedge_zero_size (424,
#     P ratio 0.8): zero-quantity hedge children of the stock parent are
#     ACCEPTED; the Gateway assigns the working quantity itself (100 for the
#     beta child, 80 = 0.8 x parent for the pair child), floors the limit to
#     0.01, binds the child to the parent's perm id via oca_group, holds it
#     PreSubmitted with why_held=child, and cancels it cleanly with
#     Cancelled + the code-202 notice.
#   - fx_hedge (423): FX hedge child on the stock parent -> code 10063
#     "Invalid FX hedge order..." delivered in the 10xxx range, so it
#     surfaces as a session event and the child handle never hears about it.
# Sibling capture 20260611T133853Z-api_hedge_order_aapl (events.jsonl sha256
# prefix 833e9477724d4c8f, same Gateway/session settings, separate session
# not replayed here) additionally attested code 10032 "Specifying size for
# hedge order is not allowed, send zero." for SIZED beta/FX/pair hedge
# children, which is why the children here carry zero quantity (empty
# total_quantity on the wire).
# The option parent (418) drew no open_order echo until its cancel was
# processed much later (PendingCancel -> Cancelled + 202), preserved here at
# its live position. The final global cancel raced the parent cancel and
# drew code 161 for order 420 before its Cancelled status; the engine closes
# that handle with the 161, so the trailing 202 for 420 is dropped.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to DU9000001, perm ids ->
# 900418/900420/900422/900424 (including inside oca_group and the code-161
# message), order refs -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260611T134021Z-001..-007.
# Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2119/2158, the driver's startup safety
# global cancel and its code-161 replies, the delayed-quote anchor exchange,
# the sec-def option parameter and contract-details qualification exchange,
# and the teardown global cancel's code-161 replies for previous scenarios'
# orders.
handshake {"server_version":200,"connection_time":"20260611 15:40:22 Central European Standard Time"}
server managed_accounts {"accounts":["DU9000001"]}
server next_valid_id {"order_id":418}
